description: The definition of a chaos run: its duration, its quiet windows, the credentials it authenticates with and its workers. The params of each driver and action are left open here and checked against the schema the named driver or kind publishes
title: io.synadia.ntf.chaos.v1.definition

quiet.description: The run's quiet windows, the fault-free stretches it guarantees. Null is read as absent

min.description: The shortest quiet window, 30s when absent

max_fault.description: The longest stretch before a quiet window is due, 2m when absent

credentials.description: How the engine authenticates to each account, keyed by account name, $SYS for the system account. Null is read as absent

workers.description: The workers, which act concurrently through the run

duration.description: A Go duration string such as 30s or 1m30s, as time.ParseDuration reads it. Whether its value is in range is checked when the definition is validated

credential.description: A credential in the keyed form: one key naming its type, whose value holds it

password.description: The password, empty when absent or null

keyed.description: A driver or kind in the keyed form: one key naming it, whose value holds its params

worker.description: A worker, pairing a driver that decides when to act with a kind that decides what to do

name.description: The worker's name, unique in the run
